data.name: About.MetaDescription
data.value: Learn about PRJ Proje Makina's history, vision, mission, 25,000 m² production facility and commitment to domestic manufacturing.

data.name: About.Lead
data.value: We bring together engineering, capacity and reliability in steel, plastic and rubber manufacturing.

data.name: About.WhoTitle
data.value: A trusted name in integrated manufacturing

data.name: About.WhoLead
data.value: PRJ Proje Makina manufactures steel, plastic and rubber spare parts for heavy machinery at its 25,000 m² facility in Ankara Sincan 1st Organized Industrial Zone.

data.name: About.WhoText1
data.value: Our facility houses a large fleet of CNC machines, hydraulic presses, rubber compounding mixers, laser cutting and bending machines, two oven-cured paint lines, a coating plant and a steel foundry.

data.name: About.WhoText2
data.value: We carry out most processes in-house, from design and production to quality control and shipment, giving us full control over cost, quality and lead time.

data.name: About.History1Text
data.value: Our journey began with rubber spare parts for heavy machinery, and we soon developed our own rubber compounds.

data.name: About.History2Text
data.value: With investments in CNC machining, laser cutting and bending, we expanded into steel component production.

data.name: About.History3Text
data.value: With a steel foundry, oven paint lines and a coating plant, we became a fully integrated manufacturer.

data.name: About.History4Text
data.value: After obtaining our Ministry of National Defense Facility Security Clearance, we began contributing to defense industry programs.

data.name: About.History5Text
data.value: Today, with more than 150 specialists, we export to more than 20 countries.

data.name: About.VisionText
data.value: To be a globally preferred solution partner in steel, plastic and rubber component manufacturing, built on technology and domestic engineering.

data.name: About.MissionText
data.value: To deliver high-quality, sustainable products that meet our customers' needs on time, while contributing to Türkiye's industrial and defense capabilities.

data.name: About.FacilityText
data.value: By combining metal, rubber and plastic production under one roof, we achieve short lead times and consistent quality.

data.name: About.HrText
data.value: Our 150+ specialists, supported by continuous training and a strong safety culture, are the most valuable part of our operation.

data.name: About.DomesticText
data.value: By developing our design and manufacturing capabilities in Türkiye, we provide 100% domestic solutions that reduce reliance on imports.

data.name: About.ExportText
data.value: We export to more than 20 countries across a region stretching from Europe to Central Asia.

data.name: Legal.PrivacyMetaDescription
data.value: PRJ Proje Makina privacy policy and personal data protection notice.

data.name: Legal.PrivacyLead
data.value: Information notice on the processing of personal data.

data.name: Legal.PrivacyIntro
data.value: At PRJ Proje Makina, we take the security of the personal data you share through our website seriously. This notice explains how we process your data as data controller under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where applicable, the GDPR.

data.name: Legal.Privacy1Text
data.value: Through our contact and quote forms we process your name, company, e-mail address, phone number, message content, any technical files you upload and, for security purposes, your IP address. If you consent to cookies, statistics on how the website is used are processed through Google Analytics; see the Cookie Policy for details.

data.name: Legal.Privacy2Text
data.value: Your data is processed to respond to your enquiries, prepare quotations, manage our business relationship and ensure information security.

data.name: Legal.Privacy3Text
data.value: We process your data on the basis of your consent, steps prior to entering into a contract and our legitimate interests.

data.name: Legal.Privacy4Text
data.value: Your data is not shared with third parties or transferred abroad, except where required by law.

data.name: Legal.Privacy5Text
data.value: Your data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purposes above or as required by law, and is then deleted or anonymised.

data.name: Legal.Privacy6Text
data.value: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection by contacting us at the e-mail address on our contact page.

data.name: Legal.CookiesMetaDescription
data.value: Information about the cookies used on the PRJ Proje Makina website.

data.name: Legal.CookiesLead
data.value: The cookies we use and why.

data.name: Legal.CookiesIntro
data.value: Our website uses cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work securely and correctly and, only with your consent, analytics cookies to measure visits. We do not use advertising cookies.

data.name: Legal.Cookies1Text
data.value: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser.

data.name: Legal.Cookies2Text
data.value: These are used for form security (CSRF protection) and post-submission messages. Forms cannot work without them.

data.name: Legal.Cookies3Text
data.value: Used only to keep authorized staff securely signed in to the administration panel.

data.name: Legal.Cookies4Text
data.value: You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie Preferences" link at the bottom of the page. You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings, although forms may stop working if strictly necessary cookies are blocked.

data.name: Legal.CookieTempData

data.name: Legal.Cookies5Text
data.value: Only with your consent, Google Analytics is used to measure how the website is used (pages visited, the visitor's country, where visits come from) as anonymous statistics. data.name: Careers.Lead

data.name: Careers.Intro
data.value: At our integrated plant in Ankara we produce for projects that range from the defense industry and automotive to construction machinery and export markets. We are looking for colleagues who take care in their work, keep learning and are ready to take responsibility. Even without an open position, we consider every application.

data.name: Careers.Why1Text
data.value: Health and safety comes first on every shift; equipment, training and inspections are renewed regularly.

data.name: Careers.Why2Text
data.value: You grow through on-the-job and classroom training in materials, tooling, quality and production techniques.

data.name: Careers.Why3Text
data.value: You contribute directly to domestic production on defense industry and export projects.

data.name: Careers.Why4Text
data.value: As your results grow, so do your responsibilities and opportunities to develop.
